claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate to improve oxygenation and acidosis.
Continue vasopressor support with norepinephrine and phenylephrine, titrating to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure.
Transfuse platelets due to severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count 11-36 K/uL) and coagulopathy.
Administer broad-spectrum antibiotics (e.g., cefepime) for suspected infection, as indicated by fever and leukocytosis.
Obtain blood cultures and other appropriate cultures to guide antimicrobial therapy.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate frequently to assess acid-base status and response to therapy.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) to guide transfusion and assess bleeding risk.
Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN, urine output) and electrolytes (potassium, phosphate, magnesium) closely.
Monitor temperature and hemodynamics for signs of sepsis or shock.
Continue sedation with midazolam and propofol, and analgesia with fentanyl, targeting a Richmond-RAS scale of -3 to -4.
